headline: RM inflation & rain led disruption dents performance

highlights: In an inflationary environment, FLAIR IN reported subdued margin performance with GM at 48.7% (PLe 49.8%) and EBITDA margin at 14.9% (PLe 15.8%).
Further, top-line growth was also modest at 6% due to operational disruptions at Valsad amid excessive rains.
Given the muted performance in 1HFY27, full year topline growth guidance has been revised downwards to ~12% (earlier ~15%).
Nonetheless, led by normalization of operations, and capacity expansion in the steel bottle segment (4th line expected to be commissioned in 4QFY27E), we expect revenue CAGR of 14% over FY26-FY29E.
